title: Mollification of a Lipschitz map at scale σ: C^∞, global and local Lipschitz bounds, derivative bound, closeness and locality of coordinates (supplied step 2)
lean_statement: ∀ (m m' : ℕ) (F : Eucl m → Eucl m') (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L F → ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → ∃ Fs : Eucl m → Eucl m', ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) Fs ∧ LipschitzWith L Fs ∧ (∀ x, ‖Fs x - F x‖ ≤ (L : ℝ) * σ) ∧ (∀ (x : Eucl m) (Λ' : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith Λ' F (ball x (2 * σ)) → LipschitzOnWith Λ' Fs (ball x σ) ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ Fs x‖ ≤ (Λ' : ℝ) ∧ ‖Fs x - F x‖ ≤ (Λ' : ℝ) * σ) ∧ ∀ (x : Eucl m) (i : Fin m') (c : ℝ), (∀ y ∈ ball x σ, F y i = c) → Fs x i = c
